messages:
alice: Heads up — after the prefetch strategy change rolled yesterday, we're seeing steady client heap growth on the console canary. Heap climbs ~60MB over 30s when switching dashboards, charts get progressively choppier. https://perf.redwood/heap/abc123 :eyes:
sam: Yikes. Is this the prefetch->aggressive mode toggle we flipped at 02:10?
jordan: Yep. I pushed the change to increase prefetch concurrency and keep more KV cache entries in memory. The idea was to reduce cold-path latency.
alice: Benchmark looked fine in staging, but production's traffic shape is different — more concurrent dashboard opens. Repro steps: open three dashboards back to back, switch timeseries range -> heap climbs.
marta: Any error logs in renderer or OOMs?
alice: No OOMs yet, just GC churn and a lot of detached nodes in devtools snapshot. Also see repeated "LZ4-decode" allocations pinned to `parseTileBatch` callstack.
leo: Could be we prefetch bigger batches now and keep raw compressed blobs in memory until decompression finishes. We might be holding references to ArrayBuffers.
jordan: That matches. We changed batching from 4->12 tiles per request and switched to storing the raw response on the request object for later reuse.
sam: Can you paste the minimal repro snippet you used?
alice: Sure: ```js
// quick repro
await api.prefetchTiles({range, concurrency: 8, batchSize: 12});
// then rapidly navigate dashboards
```
leo: If we keep raw Buffer refs around we should call `buffer.slice(0)` or copy to a new ArrayBuffer when we only need parsed data. But that creates copies and hurts perf.
jordan: We intended to reuse raw responses to avoid re-download for identical ranges. Maybe we never clear the cache entries when UI navigates away.
marta: Recommend throttling prefetch concurrency back to 3 on canary and force gc-friendly release of buffers. We can also add weak references? Browsers don't have WeakRef support everywhere; risky.
alice: Rolling a quick revert to old prefetch policy now — will monitor. Canary users will be downgraded in 5m.
deploy-bot: rolling-restart canary-console-instances (initiated by alice) — 1/4 hosts restarted
sam: While you revert, let's capture a heap snapshot and a diff so we can see retained objects. alice can you attach?
alice: Attached: https://perf.redwood/heap/snapshot-1716012345.diff. Shows large retained `Uint8Array` from `TileService._pendingResponses`
jordan: OK I see the leak: `_pendingResponses` is a Map keyed by range string but entries never evicted on view change. We added eviction only for cache hits, not for pending. Patch incoming.
leo: Small mitigation: change stored value to a promise that resolves to the parsed result and null out the raw bytes after parsing. That keeps a single parsed tree and frees the original bytes ASAP.
marta: Also double-check our source maps/stack frames — a lot of CPU time is in `sourcemap-lookup` path because error logging calls `getFriendlyStack` on every tile parse error. Could be an unrelated overhead hit when errors increase due to concurrency.
jordan: Good catch — I saw a spike in `sourcemap-lookup` calls in tracing. I will gate `getFriendlyStack` behind a rate limiter and only call for unique errors.
alice: After revert (10m) heap growth stopped on canary. Charts smoothed out. Reverting prefetch_concurrency to 4 for now.
sam: Next steps: 1) PR to evict `_pendingResponses` on view change or implement TTL 2) Null original bytes after parse 3) Rate-limit expensive telemetry like sourcemap lookups 4) Add canary metric for retained-arraybuffer-size 5) Postmortem noting why staging didn't catch this workload shape
jordan: I'll open the PRs. Will include a test that simulates rapid dashboard switching and asserts no retained ArrayBuffers after X seconds.
leo: Also add a debug flag to dump pending cache size on client so QA can run stress locally.
marta: Ops: let's keep canary at reverted prefetch and enable verbose GC tracing for 24h to ensure no lingering regressions.
alice: Thanks all. Really appreciate quick responses. Leaving TODOs in the thread: // TODOs 
- jordan: PR for pendingResponses eviction + null raw bytes
- jordan: gate sourcemap lookups
- leo: debug flag for pending cache dump
- marta: enable GC tracing on canary for 24h
- sam: coordinate release window for safe re-roll

sam: Lean plan: get small patch out tomorrow AM, ship to canary, monitor RPC latency + browser heap. If good for 6h, roll to prod.
jordan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/5823 (WIP)
alice: Verified canary stability for now. Reopen if we see other symptoms. :thumbsup:
